zw900-p063-q052-0252.intro: The table above summarizes customer satisfaction ratings for two banks, where each rating is an integer from 1 to 10. Which of the following statements are true?
options: For Bank I, if a rating is within 0.5 standard deviation of the mean rating, then the rating is 7.
For Bank II, if a rating is within 0.4 standard deviation of the mean rating, then the rating is 6.
The sum of all the ratings for Bank I is less than the sum of all the ratings for Bank II.
